subject: Cloud Computing
title: What Is Virtualization?
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: What Is Virtualization?.

hook.text: One physical server running one app wastes 85% of its capacity. That's like driving a bus alone.

buildup.text: Virtualization lets one physical server pretend to be many smaller virtual servers.

discovery.text: Each virtual machine thinks it has its own CPU, memory, and storage. It's all an illusion.

twist.text: The idea existed since the 1960s. IBM mainframes could run virtual machines decades ago.

climax.text: Modern cloud computing is built on virtualization. Without it, the cloud couldn't exist.

punchline.text: One machine pretending to be many. That's the cloud's trick.

quiz.question: What is the core idea behind virtualization?
options: One physical machine runs multiple virtual machines simultaneously
Replacing all physical hardware with software programs
Connecting many small computers into one supercomputer

details.summary: Virtualization creates software-based versions of physical hardware, allowing one server to run multiple isolated virtual machines. This technology is the foundation of cloud computing because it lets providers efficiently share physical resources among thousands of customers.
details.whyItMatters: Without virtualization, cloud computing would be economically impossible. It enables the resource sharing, isolation, and density that make pay-per-use cloud services viable.
takeaways: Virtualization creates software versions of physical hardware
One physical server can run many virtual machines
It enables the multi-tenant model that makes cloud affordable

faq.question: How does virtualization enable cloud computing?
faq.answer: Virtualization lets cloud providers run many customers' workloads on shared physical servers while keeping them isolated. This multi-tenancy dramatically improves hardware utilization, reduces costs, and allows resources to be provisioned in seconds instead of weeks.

faq.question: Is virtualization the same as cloud computing?
faq.answer: No. Virtualization is a technology; cloud computing is a service model. You can use virtualization without cloud, and modern cloud technologies like containers go beyond traditional virtualization. But virtualization was the enabling technology that made cloud computing practical.
